# Tangerine

> Tangerine is a Canadian digital bank offering no-fee personal and business banking, savings accounts, credit cards, and investment products with competitive interest rates.

Tangerine provides comprehensive online banking solutions for Canadian customers, featuring registered accounts (TFSA, RRSP, RIF), savings products, chequing accounts, award-winning credit cards, and mobile banking tools. The platform emphasizes no-fee banking, high interest rates, and digital-first financial management.

## Key Topics

- No-fee banking
- Savings accounts
- TFSA (Tax-Free Savings Account)
- RRSP (Registered Retirement Savings Plan)
- GIC (Guaranteed Investment Certificate)
- Credit cards with cash back
- Mobile banking app
- Digital banking
- Interest rates
- RIF (Retirement Income Fund)
- Chequing account
- Tangerine Investments
- High-interest savings
- New client offers
- Visa Debit

## Personal Banking

- [Personal Online Banking: Digital Banking in Canada | Tangerine](https://www.tangerine.ca/en/personal): Tangerine's personal banking hub offering savings, investments, and credit cards.
- [Services bancaires personnels en ligne : Services bancaires numériques au Canada | Tangerine](https://www.tangerine.ca/fr/particuliers): French-language personal banking hub for Canadian customers.

## Savings & Registered Accounts

- [Save | Tangerine](https://www.tangerine.ca/en/personal/save): Overview of Tangerine's savings products and registered accounts.
- [Savings Account | Tangerine](https://www.tangerine.ca/en/personal/save/savings-account): Tangerine Savings Account with no fees and competitive interest rates.
- [TFSA Savings Account - Interest Rate of 4.60% for 5 months², TFSA Promotion | Tangerine](https://www.tangerine.ca/en/personal/save/tfsa): Tax-Free Savings Account with promotional interest rates and no fees.
- [RSP Savings Account | Tangerine](https://www.tangerine.ca/en/personal/save/rsp): RRSP savings account for tax-sheltered retirement planning.
- [Retirement Income Fund (RIF) Savings Account | Tangerine](https://www.tangerine.ca/en/personal/save/rif): RIF account for retirement income with tax-sheltered growth.
- [US Dollar Savings Account | Tangerine](https://www.tangerine.ca/en/personal/save/us-dollar-savings-account): US dollar savings account with no fees and competitive rates.
- [Children's Savings Account | Tangerine](https://www.tangerine.ca/en/personal/save/childrens-savings-account): Joint savings account for children with no fees and financial education.

## Spending & Credit

- [No-Fee Chequing Account: Open an Account Online | Tangerine](https://www.tangerine.ca/en/personal/spend/chequing-account): No-fee chequing account with Visa Debit and unlimited e-transfers.
- [No Annual Fee Credit Cards in Canada - Tangerine's Award-Winning Credit Cards | Tangerine](https://www.tangerine.ca/en/personal/spend/credit-cards): Award-winning credit cards with no annual fee and cash back rewards.

## Business Banking

- [Online Business Banking in Canada | Tangerine](https://www.tangerine.ca/en/business): Business banking solutions with accounts, GICs, and mobile tools for Canadian businesses.

- [Chequing Account Offers: $250 Bonus Offer¹ | Tangerine](https://www.tangerine.ca/en/offers/chequing-account-promo): $250 bonus promotion for new chequing account with direct deposit.
